purpose: Teach: 総体/元祖/置き場/アウトソーシング/空調/積立/延べ/一様

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界総体の傾向を把握しましょう
lines.en: Let's get a clear picture of industry-wide trends.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient opening. Clipped consonants. Forward momentum. The tone of someone running through a checklist with purpose but no drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元祖商品のリブランドを進めます
lines.en: Yes — we'll move forward with rebranding the original product line.
lines.style: Prompt, assured confirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Clean delivery of the action item. Professional but not stiff — showing he's already thinking about execution.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 倉庫の置き場をマップ化しましょう
lines.en: And let's map out the warehouse storage layout.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Brief pause before the instruction, like checking she has his attention. Steady pace. Practical, no inflection.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コールセンターのアウトソーシングを進めます
lines.en: Yes — I'll get us estimates on outsourcing the call center.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Takes ownership with the pronoun. Efficient tone. Adding the task to his mental list as he speaks, not rushed but compact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスの空調も省エネ化しましょう
lines.en: We should also look at energy-efficient options for the office HVAC.
lines.style: Same directive tone, slightly softened by 'also' — building the list. Measured tempo. No urgency, just steady progress through items.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員退職積立の試算を出します
lines.en: Yes — I'll pull projections on the executive severance reserve.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact confirmation. Clean tone. Professional distance maintained while acknowledging he understands the financial weight of the request.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 展示会の延べ来場者数を集計しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we have a total count of attendees at the trade show.
lines.style: Clear directive. Light emphasis on 'total' — precision matters here. Final item in the series, so slight settling in the voice. Still brisk but complete.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。一様なサービス品質を維持します
lines.en: Yes — and we'll maintain consistent service quality across the board.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight broadening in scope — moving from specific tasks to the bigger picture. Assured and grounding. The closing note of someone who's understood the whole meeting.
